ignoreValues.reason: False positive: the detector cannot resolve Tailwind's responsive text-size utilities (h1 is text-4xl/sm:text-6xl/lg:text-7xl, h2 is text-3xl/sm:text-5xl, etc.) and falls back to the unresolved 16px base for every role. Verified by inspection: real hierarchy exists at every breakpoint. The one genuinely flat case (course-card h3 at text-base, matching body) is a deliberate dense-ledger/registry-card treatment consistent with the chosen direction, not an oversight.

False positive: the RTO 45906 span inherits text-ground (cream) from its parent div (bg-ink text-ground); detector's color-resolution pass fails on this inheritance chain, same known limitation documented elsewhere in this operator's projects.

Intentional: this is the new line-mark token (#C2BCAE), now documented in DESIGN.md, used for the crosshair registration-mark ticks specifically to read as a quieter secondary mark than the main hairline color.

Intentional: a small 2px radius on the focus-visible outline only, to avoid a harsh pixel-perfect corner on some browsers' outline rendering, within a system whose shape language is otherwise rounded:none.

Client's brief explicitly named Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) and Inter (body/nav/buttons) by face, verbatim, as a requirement for this round's redesign -- the brief wins over the general anti-cliche-font guidance.
